movie.title: Crawlers
movie.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a traveler unwittingly introduces an aggressive new breed of venomous arachnids to an apartment building, the residents are locked inside a deadly quarantine and forced to fight for survival.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Returning home from an overseas trip, a man unknowingly transports a lethal and highly invasive species of spider into his residential apartment block. Terrified authorities swiftly isolate the building, leaving the helpless occupants trapped inside without rescue. As the venomous swarm multiplies and stalks the hallways, the residents must band together to endure the terrifying nightmare. Survival becomes a desperate, claustrophobic race against time as the spiders claim victim after victim.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After returning home from an abroad expedition, an unsuspecting traveler brings back an undiscovered, highly aggressive breed of venomous spiders. Unbeknownst to him, the creatures escape into the building's ventilation system, quickly establishing a rapidly multiplying colony. As residents begin suffering mysterious, deadly bites, panic spreads throughout the complex. Upon discovering the dangerous infestation, emergency services enact a strict, non-negotiable quarantine, sealing off every exit and trapping everyone inside. Cut off from the outside world, the tenants are forced to navigate dark corridors and infested rooms as the spiders grow increasingly territorial. Tensions rise sharply within the trapped community as fear, mistrust, and desperation split the survivors into opposing groups. Resourceful individuals improvise weapons and barricades to defend their makeshift safe zones against the unrelenting swarm. With the venomous threat mounting and time running out, a small group of survivors attempts a high-stakes escape through the heart of the spider-infested building. Ultimately, their ordeal tests the absolute limits of human resilience, sacrifice, and survival instinct under siege.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Crawlers is a tense creature-feature thriller that explores the terrifying consequences of an unexpected ecological threat contained within a confined space. When a man returns from a trip inadvertently carrying a lethal, fast-breeding species of spider, his apartment complex becomes ground zero for a devastating infestation. Rather than providing aid, local authorities seal the perimeter, leaving the residents quarantined and left to fend for themselves against a relentless, venomous predator. The narrative dives into horror, suspense, and human drama as ordinary people are forced into an extraordinary fight for survival against a hidden threat crawling through the walls.

story_structure.climax: The desperate struggle for survival reaches a peak as the remaining residents face a high-stakes, life-or-death confrontation against the heart of the spider swarm to secure an escape.
story_structure.conflict: The venomous spiders quickly multiply and infest the building, forcing authorities to quarantine the entire apartment block and leaving the residents trapped inside.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate nightmare subsides as the survivors deal with the aftermath of the infestation and assess the costly toll of their fight for freedom.
story_structure.introduction: A man returns home from a trip to his apartment building, completely unaware that he has brought back a new and dangerous breed of arachnid.
story_structure.risingAction: As the infestation spreads out of control, the isolated tenants must band together, utilize limited resources, and navigate the increasingly treacherous building to survive the growing threat.
